name: sql-analyzer-pro
description: AI-powered SQL analysis tool with separated frontend and backend architecture

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules server/node_modules frontend/node_modules server/dist frontend/.next
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:frontend
